segments.thi-ap32:2.3: Cātuddīpā bahū kaññā, pure tuyhaṃ mahāmune.
segments.thi-ap32:3.3: Devā ca kinnarā nāgā, phusissanti anāgate.
segments.thi-ap32:4.3: Tumhaṃ [tvayi (sī. pī.)] pasādaṃ paṭiladdhā, bujjhissanti anāgate.
segments.thi-ap32:5.3: Pekkhato no [lakkhaṇā ca (syā.)] mahāvīra, pāde vandāma cakkhuma.
segments.thi-ap32:8.3: Sududdasaṃ padaṃ gantvā, anujānātha [anujānimha (syā. pī. ka.)] nāyaka.
segments.thi-ap32:9.3: Catunnaṃ saṃsayaṃ chetvā, sabbā gacchantu nibbutiṃ.
segments.thi-ap32:14.3: Dassayiṃsu balaṃ sabbā, pāde vandiṃsu satthuno.
segments.thi-ap32:17.3: Ñāṇaṃ amhaṃ mahāvīra, uppannaṃ tava santike.
segments.thi-ap32:19.1: “Yaṃ amhehi kataṃ kammaṃ, kusalaṃ sara taṃ mune;
segments.thi-ap32:21.3: Ubbaḷhā nadiyā bhikkhū, gamanaṃ na labhanti te.
segments.thi-ap32:22.1: “Divasaṃ dve tayo ceva, sattāhaṃ māsikaṃ tato;
segments.thi-ap32:22.3: Catumāsampi sampuṇṇaṃ, gamanaṃ na labhanti te.
segments.thi-ap32:23.3: Oruddhe [oratīre (syā.)] bhikkhavo disvā, setuṃ gaṅgāya kārayi.
segments.thi-ap32:25.3: Tassa setuṃ vihārañca [tesu setuvihāresu (sī.), tassa setū vihāre ca (pī.)], samabhāgaṃ akaṃsu te.
segments.thi-ap32:26.3: Tassa dhammesu dāyādā, nagare janapadesu ca.
segments.thi-ap32:27.1: “Itthī pumā kumārā ca, bahū ceva kumārikā;
segments.thi-ap32:27.3: Setuno ca vihārassa, vālukā ākiriṃsu te.
segments.thi-ap32:28.3: Dhūpaṃ cuṇṇañca mālañca, kāraṃ katvāna satthuno.
segments.thi-ap32:38.3: Cikkhallabhūmimasuciṃ [cikkhallaṃ bhūmiṃ gamanaṃ (syā.)], na passāma mahāmune.
segments.thi-ap32:39.3: Upanenti sadā sabbaṃ, pubbakammaphalena no [pubbakammaphalaṃ tato (sī. pī.)].
segments.thi-ap32:40.3: Saṃsārapathanitthiṇṇā, vītarāgā bhavāmase [natthi dāni punabbhavo (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.thi-ap32:41.3: Upanenti sadā amhe, sahassāni tato tato.
segments.thi-ap32:43.1: “Svāgataṃ vata no āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thi-ap32:45.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ caturāsītibrāhmaṇakaññābhikkhunīsahassāni bhagavato sammukhā imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
